title: Applying Patient Pay Payments, Past-Due Notices and Credit Refunds — Medical Assistance
content:
**Clauses in force.** Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a patient pay payment names the charge it pays and is applied only up to that charge's open balance; an unallocated payment is applied oldest service month first. Patient pay is accepted by the listed methods; a transfer from the resident's trust account is posted only on the resident's authorization recorded with the trust account, and where the center is the resident's representative payee, patient pay is transferred on the representative payee transfer day each month. A written past-due notice is sent once for a charge still unpaid the past-due notice days after its due date.

**Refund clause no longer in force in its original form.** The clause "a patient pay credit balance is refunded within the refund days, to the resident or representative, or to the estate after a death" is no longer in force as an unqualified rule. Current wording: a patient pay credit balance is refunded within the refund days, to the resident or representative, or to the estate after a death; when the representative of an approved case pays toward the coming month while a credit that arose from a reduction posted within the refund days stands on the case, that credit is instead applied to the coming month up to the patient pay the coming month will carry, and only for such a payment; when the representative of a pending case pays toward the coming month while such a credit stands on the case, that credit is instead applied to the coming month up to the base estimate figure, and only for such a payment; every other credit balance is refunded under the base rule.

**The settings these clauses read** (the same on every tier): accepted methods are check, money order, ACH, trust transfer and representative payee transfer; the representative payee transfer day is the 5th; the past-due notice follows 30 calendar days after the due date; refunds are made within 30 calendar days; after a death the refund is paid to the estate.

**Applying a payment — hypothetical figures.**

| Payment | Charge named | Open balance of that charge | Applied to that charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400.00 | one service month's charge | 365.20 | 365.20 |
| 120.00 | one service month's charge | 365.20 | 120.00 |

A payment that names no charge is applied to the oldest open service month first.

**Basis Q&A.**

*Can a transfer from the resident's trust account be posted on a family member's say-so?* Only on the resident's authorization recorded with the trust account.

*How many written past-due notices does one unpaid charge receive?* One, once the charge is still unpaid 30 calendar days after its due date.

superseded_clauses: A patient pay credit balance is refunded within the refund days, to the resident or representative, or to the estate after a death.
